description: Standard Sword Agent OS profile. This is not a minimal demo.

startup_stages.meaning: No basic runtime reflex response is available; treat the OS as not alive enough to operate.
The OS substrate can return a simple liveness or status reflex without requiring full thought-core turn processing.
The OS can process a minimum text turn, return Thought Core response events, and project the result into status and event history.

health_model.availability_policy: Standard organ capabilities may be blocked, unavailable, or degraded without making OS boot unhealthy unless a profile explicitly marks them boot-critical.
